settings.intro_highlight: Engineered to optimize practitioner body mechanics, the Elite Spa treatment chair eliminates physical fatigue during extended clinical protocols while maintaining superior client positioning.
settings.custom_description: The Elite Spa is purpose-built for licensed professionals, including Estheticians, Medical Spa Therapists, and Cosmetic Injectors. Its adjustable-height design targets lower-back tension during high-volume clinic days, enabling sharper focus on treatment execution and repeatable results. Whether you are performing deep-pore cleansing, microdermabrasion, or post-procedure recovery, this professional station adjusts to your optimal working height.
settings.subtitle: Height Adjustment System
settings.secondary_description: Easy maintenance is central to the Equipro approach. To preserve the structural integrity and plush finish of Elite Spa, wipe down the upholstery with non-abrasive surface disinfectants formulated for clinical spa environments after every client session. The heavy-duty vinyl surface features superior chemical resistance, ensuring a pristine condition outcome across years of continuous daily operation. Consistent care prevents surface cracking, protecting your capital investment.

settings.question: UEstheticians and Facial Specialists:
settings.answer: Extended facial protocols like manual extraction, microdermabrasion, and facial contouring demand steady hands and sustained upper-body posture. The adjustable-height station allows estheticians to raise the table precisely to elbow level, eliminating thoracic bending and reducing shoulder fatigue during intricate 90-minute facial care sessions.

settings.question: Clinical Spa Therapists and Body Specialists:
settings.answer: Performing intensive body wraps, exfoliation treatments, and targeted therapies requires leveraging body weight without straining the lumbar spine. By setting the table near the listed 22-inch minimum height, therapists can easily apply firm, downward pressure while maintaining neutral posture, improving force distribution and operational efficiency.

settings.question: Cosmetic Injectors and Spa Techs:
settings.answer: Precision aesthetic procedures demand absolute client stability and customizable positioning. The Elite Spa enables precise height calibration to line up the client’s face directly with the injector's field of sight, minimizing neck strain for the technician while ensuring maximum comfort and security for the client.

settings.title: Streamlined Architectural Profile
settings.text: Clean aesthetic quality that complements any high-end medical spa or wellness interior.

settings.heading: Key Features for the Professional Station

settings.text: Set the table to its listed minimum height of 22 inches to facilitate client entry.
Once the client is seated, adjust the working height within the listed 22-to-39-inch range to suit the treatment protocol.
Insert the optional adjustable crescent headrest into the mounting sockets at the head section to provide enhanced cervical support during prone or supine procedures.
Return the chair to its lowest height setting before instructing the client to step off the station.
Do not exceed the maximum operational load capacity specified for the base structure; ensure clients are centered on the main cushion prior to adjusting height.
Keep the area around the lifting frame clear of obstructions during height changes.

settings.question: What is the height adjustment range of the Elite Spa chair?
settings.answer: The unit adjusts vertically from 22 inches to 39 inches. This ensures customized ergonomic positioning for practitioners of any height.

settings.question: Is an adjustable headrest included with the Elite Spa unit?
settings.answer: An adjustable crescent headrest is available as an optional accessory. It provides extra cervical support for advanced facial and body protocols.

settings.question: What color options are available for this treatment table?
settings.answer: The Elite Spa is manufactured exclusively in a sleek professional white finish. It integrates seamlessly into modern spa decor.

settings.question: What treatments can be performed on the Elite Spa station?
settings.answer: It is ideal for facials, body treatments, massages, and hair removal. The versatile design adapts easily across multidisciplinary clinics.

settings.question: What warranty coverage comes with the Equipro Elite Spa chair?
settings.answer: Equipro lists a 1-year warranty for Elite Spa EI-508. Parts-and-labor coverage and electrical-component safety standards are not confirmed in the model-specific entry.
